strategies.name: Liquidation Cascade Predictor
strategies.reference: Zeeshan Ali (2025) 'Anatomy of the Oct 10-11 2025 Crypto Liquidation Cascade' — SSRN 5611392; BeInCrypto on-chain analysis; Amberdata liquidation guide
strategies.concept: Predict cascading liquidations by monitoring OI concentration at specific price levels via Coinglass liquidation heatmap data. When OI clusters heavily at nearby price levels (within 2-5% of current price) AND leverage ratio exceeds historical 90th percentile AND exchange inflows drop below 30K BTC, a cascade is imminent. The Oct 2025 event ($19B liquidated) showed these signals emerged 7-20 days before the crash. Trade: short when cascade conditions align, or exit longs preemptively.
strategies.data_requirements: Coinglass API (liquidation heatmap, OI by price level), Binance OI data (already have), exchange inflow data (CryptoQuant), SOPR ratio
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have OI analysis and liquidation_cascade_bottom (detects AFTER cascade). This PREDICTS cascades before they happen using OI concentration mapping. Completely different approach.

strategies.name: Gamma Exposure (GEX) Dealer Hedging Flow
strategies.reference: Glassnode 'Taker-Flow-Based Gamma Exposure' (2025); Halcyon Waters 'Bitcoin Gamma Walls'; SSRN 5782822 'Do Gamma Walls Actually Move Bitcoin Prices at Deribit?'
strategies.concept: Track net gamma exposure of options market makers on Deribit. When dealers are net short gamma near a strike, they must buy dips and sell rallies (mean-reverting pin). When dealers are net long gamma, moves accelerate. Trade near high-GEX strikes for mean reversion; trade breakouts when GEX flips from positive to negative. The $86K-$110K gamma plateau in late 2025 predicted BTC grinding behavior for weeks. Note: SSRN paper debates effectiveness — BTC GEX is ~0.025% of daily volume, so only works as confluence filter, not standalone.
strategies.data_requirements: Deribit options chain (already have DVOL), Amberdata GEX endpoint, Laevitas.ch GEX data, strike-level OI
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have gamma_squeeze_proxy (price-based heuristic) and max_pain_gravitational. GEX is fundamentally different — it measures DEALER HEDGING FLOWS from actual options positions, not price proxies.

strategies.name: Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) Multi-Horizon Predictor
strategies.reference: Lee (2025) 'TFT-Based Trading Strategy for Multi-Crypto Assets' — MDPI Systems 13(6):474; Arxiv 2509.10542 'Adaptive TFT for Crypto'; Canadian AI 2025 'TFT with Subseries'
strategies.concept: TFT architecture combines self-attention for long-range dependencies with LSTM gates for local patterns, plus variable selection networks that automatically identify which features matter most at each timestep. Unlike our RF/XGBoost/LightGBM models, TFT provides interpretable attention weights showing WHICH features drove each prediction. Feed on-chain (SOPR, TVL, active addresses, exchange net flow) + technical (RSI, MACD) + sentiment (Fear&Greed). The adaptive variant auto-adjusts lookback window based on detected volatility regime. Academic results: 51.4% directional accuracy on 10-min ETH (outperforms LSTM/GRU), 4%+ profit over 2 weeks vs buy-and-hold.
strategies.data_requirements: Same data we already collect (OHLCV, RSI, MACD, Fear&Greed). Needs PyTorch + pytorch-forecasting library. GPU recommended for training.
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have RF/XGBoost/LightGBM/GradientBoosting. TFT is a different architecture entirely — attention-based transformer with built-in variable selection. Provides interpretability our current ML models lack.

strategies.name: FinBERT-BiLSTM Sentiment Fusion
strategies.reference: Arxiv 2411.12748 'FinBERT-BiLSTM: Predicting Volatile Cryptocurrency Market Prices Using Market Sentiment Dynamics' (2024)
strategies.concept: Replace our current basic sentiment analysis with FinBERT (financial domain-specific BERT) processing crypto news headlines, combined with BiLSTM to capture temporal sentiment dynamics. The paper reports 98% accuracy for intra-day BTC prediction and 97% for ETH. Key insight: sentiment VELOCITY (how fast sentiment changes) matters more than absolute sentiment level. A separate study shows GPT-3-based OPT model achieves 74.4% accuracy with Sharpe ratio 3.05 on a long-short sentiment strategy. Implementation: scrape CoinDesk/CoinTelegraph headlines, run through FinBERT, feed sentiment embeddings + price data into BiLSTM.
strategies.data_requirements: News headline feeds (CoinDesk API, CoinTelegraph RSS), HuggingFace FinBERT model (ProsusAI/finbert), Twitter/X API for social data, GPU for inference
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have news_sentiment_strategies.py using basic NLP and LunarCrush social data. FinBERT is a domain-specific transformer that understands financial language nuances ('bearish divergence' vs 'bear market'). BiLSTM adds temporal memory of how sentiment evolves.

strategies.name: Cross-Exchange Funding Rate Spread Arbitrage
strategies.reference: ScienceDirect (2025) 'Exploring Risk and Return Profiles of Funding Rate Arbitrage on CEX and DEX'; Pendle Boros 'Cross-Exchange Funding Rate Arbitrage'; Amberdata 'Ultimate Guide to Funding Rate Arbitrage'
strategies.concept: Monitor funding rates across 5+ exchanges simultaneously (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, dYdX, Drift). When funding rate spread between two exchanges exceeds 20bps, go long on the negative-rate exchange and short on the positive-rate exchange. Delta-neutral profit from rate differential. Backtested: 115.9% return over 6 months with max 1.92% drawdown. Average 11.4% weighted APR, peaking at 23.5%. Key: CEX dominates price discovery (61% higher integration than DEX), so CEX-to-DEX flow is predictable.
strategies.data_requirements: Funding rate APIs from Binance, Bybit, OKX (already have scrapers), Hyperliquid, dYdX. Need real-time rate monitoring (<1 min latency).
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have funding_rate_carry (single exchange) and cross_exchange_basis_carry (futures basis). This is CROSS-EXCHANGE FUNDING RATE SPREAD — simultaneously monitoring rate differentials across 5+ venues for delta-neutral arb.

strategies.name: DEX-CEX Price Lead-Lag Signal
strategies.reference: Arxiv 2507.08302 'Arbitrage on Decentralized Exchanges' (2025); Amberdata 'Developing and Backtesting DEX/CEX Arbitrage Trading Strategies'; Cryptowisser 'Arbitrage in 2025'
strategies.concept: DEX prices sometimes lead CEX by seconds to minutes during high-activity periods (new token listings, whale moves, MEV activity). Monitor Uniswap/PancakeSwap prices vs Binance/Coinbase for the same asset. When DEX price moves >0.3% ahead of CEX, it signals impending CEX price movement in the same direction. Not pure arbitrage (too competitive) — use as a DIRECTIONAL SIGNAL: if DEX price jumps 2% while CEX is flat, go long on CEX perps. Research confirms: gas fees increase with price discrepancies, and CEX-to-DEX information flow is one-directional, meaning DEX occasionally leads on information not yet reflected in CEX.
strategies.data_requirements: DEX price feeds (Uniswap V3 subgraph, DexScreener API), CEX prices (Binance websocket — already have). Need <5 second latency for signal value.
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have cross_chain_dex_arbitrage.py and cross_chain_real.py but these are EXECUTION strategies. This is a DIRECTIONAL SIGNAL — using DEX price leads to predict CEX moves.

strategies.name: Options Expiry Pin / Max Pain Gravitational Pull Enhanced
strategies.reference: CoinDesk 'Bitcoin Options $27B Year-End Reset' (2025); CryptoSlate '$55B Options Market'; Paradigm 'Shape of Opportunity'
strategies.concept: Enhanced version of max pain: combine max pain strike with actual GEX positioning and time-to-expiry decay. In the 48-72 hours before major expiries (>$5B notional), BTC gravitates toward the max pain strike with 65-70% reliability. The key enhancement: weight by NOTIONAL SIZE of the expiry. The Dec 26, 2025 expiry ($27B) caused a 2-week gravity pull toward $100K. When a single expiry towers over others, hedging flows bunch predictably. Trade: fade moves away from max pain in the 3 days before large expiries; trade breakouts AFTER expiry.
strategies.data_requirements: Deribit options data (already have), expiry calendar, strike-level OI, notional sizing data
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have max_pain_gravitational but it's a basic implementation. This adds NOTIONAL WEIGHTING, TIME DECAY ACCELERATION, and GEX overlay — making it expiry-size-aware rather than treating all expiries equally.

strategies.name: LOB Microstructure Imbalance (100ms Resolution)
strategies.reference: Arxiv 2507.22712 'Order Book Filtration and Directional Signal Extraction at HF' (2025); Arxiv 2506.05764 'Exploring Microstructural Dynamics in Cryptocurrency LOBs' (2025); PMC 12315853 'Deep LOB Forecasting'
strategies.concept: High-frequency order book imbalance (OBI) measured at 100ms-1s intervals predicts short-term price direction with near-linear relationship. The 2025 paper on BTC/USDT LOB snapshots from Bybit showed that structural filtration of LOB data improves directional signal clarity. Key innovation: instead of raw bid/ask imbalance, compute MULTI-LEVEL imbalance across top 5-10 levels, and use a CNN/LSTM hybrid to detect spoofing vs genuine order flow. Works best for 10-second to 5-minute predictions.
strategies.data_requirements: Bybit or Binance L2 order book websocket (100ms snapshots), significant data storage for training. Need sub-second processing.
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have orderbook_strategies.py and VPIN. Those use aggregated volume analysis. This is RAW L2 ORDER BOOK at 100ms resolution with multi-level imbalance and ML-based spoofing detection.

strategies.name: TWAP/VWAP Institutional Execution Detection
strategies.reference: Arxiv 2502.13722 'Deep Learning for VWAP Execution in Crypto Markets' (2025); Amberdata 'Comparing Global VWAP and TWAP'; Talos 'Execution Insights Through TCA'
strategies.concept: Detect when institutions are executing large TWAP/VWAP orders by analyzing trade flow patterns. Institutions split large orders into predictable time/volume-weighted chunks. Signature: consistent small-to-medium trades at regular intervals over hours, volume tracking the VWAP curve closely. When detected, the institutional flow direction predicts continued price movement in that direction for 4-24 hours. A 2025 deep learning framework for VWAP execution detection achieves significant accuracy. TWAP on major platforms reduces slippage by 15-22% — meaning institutional TWAP execution leaves a detectable footprint.
strategies.data_requirements: Trade-level data from Binance/Bybit (tick data), volume profile analysis, pattern recognition model
strategies.novel_vs_existing: Completely new. We detect whale transactions (single large trades) but NOT systematic institutional execution algorithms (TWAP/VWAP patterns spread across hours).

strategies.name: Volatility Term Structure Regime Signal
strategies.reference: Paradigm 'Shape of Opportunity: Futures Term Structure in Crypto vs TradFi' (2025); CoinDesk 'BTC Futures Return to Deepest Backwardation Since FTX' (Dec 2025); CFBenchmarks 'Revisiting the Bitcoin Basis'
strategies.concept: Monitor the shape of BTC/ETH futures term structure (contango vs backwardation) as a regime indicator. Deep backwardation (annualized basis < -2%) has historically appeared near major bottoms (FTX collapse, Dec 2025 crash). Steep contango (>15% annualized) signals euphoria/top. In July 2025, SOL/XRP basis spiked to 50% annualized — preceding a correction. Trade: buy when term structure flips from backwardation to contango (recovery signal); sell when contango exceeds 2 standard deviations above mean.
strategies.data_requirements: Futures prices across maturities (Binance quarterly futures, CME BTC futures, Deribit futures). Calculated from data we can already access.
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have cross_exchange_basis_carry (executes basis trades) and funding_term_structure in config. This is a REGIME SIGNAL — using term structure SHAPE to classify market state, not to trade basis directly.

strategies.name: Variance Risk Premium (VRP) Harvesting
strategies.reference: Panoptic 'Variance Risk Premium with Onchain Synthetic Perps' (July 2025); Paradigm volatility research
strategies.concept: The variance risk premium is the difference between IMPLIED volatility and REALIZED volatility. In crypto, IV consistently overprices realized vol by 10-30% (risk premium paid by hedgers). When VRP is abnormally high (IV >> RV), sell options/volatility. When VRP compresses or inverts (RV > IV), it signals an impending volatility explosion — buy options or enter directional trades. The Panoptic study shows this works with onchain synthetic perps. Key metric: 30d IV minus 30d RV, normalized by historical VRP distribution.
strategies.data_requirements: Deribit IV data (already have DVOL), historical price data for RV calculation (already have), options chain for strike-specific IV
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have DVOL and options_volatility_strategies.py with IV rank/skew. VRP is a DIFFERENT metric — the spread between implied and realized vol, which is a proven alpha source in tradfi that transfers to crypto.

strategies.name: Hyperliquid Whale Consensus Tracker
strategies.reference: Medium/@gwrx2005 'Hyperliquid Trading Behavior' (2025); Ainvest 'Whale Short-Selling Dynamics on Hyperliquid'; HyperTracker.io; CoinGlass Hyperliquid whale data
strategies.concept: Track the top 20 whales on Hyperliquid ($50M+ accounts) and generate consensus signals. A 77-day study showed following these whales yielded 98.6% win rate and 12% P&L ratio. Key: when 3+ whales take the same directional bet within 24 hours, it's a high-confidence signal. Current data: whale exposure is $3.64B with near 1:1 long/short ratio — when this ratio breaks decisively (e.g., 1.3:1 long), it predicts the next major move. Also track whale dormancy reactivation (wallets dormant 2+ years suddenly depositing $4M+).
strategies.data_requirements: Hyperliquid on-chain data (public — already scraping via copy_trader_intel), HyperTracker API, CoinGlass Hyperliquid endpoint
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have Hyperliquid copy trader scraping but we track INDIVIDUAL traders. This aggregates TOP-20 WHALE CONSENSUS — a meta-signal from the collective positioning of the largest accounts, plus dormant wallet reactivation.

strategies.name: Social Sentiment Velocity Indicator
strategies.reference: Springer 'Wisdom of the Crowd Signals: Predictive Power of Social Media Trading Signals for Cryptocurrencies' (2025); Nature 'Attention-augmented CNN-LSTM for Social Media Sentiment' (2025); Ainvest 'Leveraging Contrarian Social Media Sentiment for Crypto Gains'
strategies.concept: Not the LEVEL of sentiment that matters, but the RATE OF CHANGE (velocity) and ACCELERATION of sentiment shift. A sudden spike in positive sentiment velocity (e.g., tweet volume up 300% in 4 hours with sentiment shifting from 0.3 to 0.7) precedes price moves by 2-6 hours. Contrarian angle: when sentiment velocity peaks and starts declining while price is still rising, it's a SELL signal (smart money selling into retail euphoria). Combining NLP sentiment velocity with on-chain data achieved 252% cumulative return in a multi-year study. Quantitative hedge funds using AI-driven sentiment strategies averaged 48% return in 2025.
strategies.data_requirements: Twitter/X API, Reddit API, LunarCrush (already have), Telegram group monitors. Need real-time NLP processing (can use local FinBERT or API).
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have LunarCrush social data and news_sentiment_strategies.py. But we use ABSOLUTE sentiment level. This measures VELOCITY (first derivative) and ACCELERATION (second derivative) of sentiment — a fundamentally different signal.

strategies.name: Helformer Seasonal Decomposition Predictor
strategies.reference: Journal of Big Data (2025) 'Helformer: an attention-based deep learning model for cryptocurrency price forecasting' — Springer s40537-025-01135-4
strategies.concept: Helformer integrates Holt-Winters exponential smoothing with Transformer architecture, decomposing price into LEVEL, TREND, and SEASONALITY components before applying attention. This captures crypto's known patterns: weekend effects, Asian session vs US session patterns, monthly expiry cycles, quarter-end rebalancing. Unlike raw Transformer on prices, Helformer's decomposition makes the model robust to regime changes because it models each component separately. Particularly effective for 4H and daily timeframe predictions.
strategies.data_requirements: Historical OHLCV data (already have), seasonal calendar data (options expiry dates, FOMC dates, ETF rebalancing dates)
strategies.novel_vs_existing: Completely new architecture. We have no seasonal decomposition model. Holt-Winters + Transformer is a novel combination not present in our RF/XGB/LGBM stack.

strategies.name: MEV Flow Direction Detector
strategies.reference: Arkham 'Beginners Guide to MEV' (2025); CoinCryptoRank 'MEV Auction Strategy' (2025); Coinbase 'What are Frontrunners and MEV'
strategies.concept: Monitor MEV bot activity on Ethereum/Solana as a leading indicator. When MEV bots suddenly increase sandwich attack volume on a specific token, it signals incoming large retail buy pressure (because sandwich bots profit from front-running large buys). Aggregate MEV activity by token to detect: (1) tokens about to see volume spikes, (2) direction of large pending orders. In 2025, MEV arbitrage generated $3.37M profit in 30 days (Sept 2025). 80% of ETH transactions now use protected RPCs — but the 20% on public mempool still leak directional information. NOT about doing MEV — about using MEV ACTIVITY as a sentiment/flow indicator.
strategies.data_requirements: MEV data providers (Flashbots API, MEV Blocker stats), Ethereum mempool monitoring, Solana Jito MEV data
strategies.novel_vs_existing: Completely new. We don't monitor MEV activity at all. This uses MEV bots' behavior as an INFORMATION SOURCE rather than competing with them.

strategies.name: Stablecoin Mint/Burn Velocity Signal
strategies.reference: MEXC News 'USDC Minted 250M Surge Signals Major Liquidity Move' (2025); Amberdata 'On-Chain Guides: Token Mints and Burns'; Ainvest 'USDC Minting vs Stablecoin Stagnation Flow Analysis' (Feb 2026)
strategies.concept: Enhanced version of stablecoin flow: track not just net flow but MINT/BURN events from Tether Treasury and Circle Treasury specifically. A single $250M USDC mint is 'rarely speculative — it usually represents a confirmed institutional order.' Key signals: (1) Net minting >$500M in 24h = bullish (institutional buying incoming), (2) Net burning >$1B in a week = bearish (capital fleeing), (3) USDC/USDT ratio shift signals regulatory-driven capital rotation. In early 2026, total stablecoin supply shrank $5.6B — correctly predicting BTC weakness. Track at entity level (which Treasury, which exchange wallet) for higher signal quality.
strategies.data_requirements: On-chain data (Etherscan for USDT/USDC contract events — already have Etherscan scraper), Treasury wallet monitoring, CryptoQuant stablecoin supply metrics
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have stablecoin_flow_momentum which tracks NET FLOW percentage. This tracks SPECIFIC MINT/BURN EVENTS from Treasury wallets at entity level — much higher signal quality and faster detection.

strategies.name: GMM-VAR Regime Classifier
strategies.reference: AIMS Press DSFE 5(3):419-439 (2025) 'GMM-VAR Framework for Crypto Regime Detection'; MDPI Mathematics 13(10):1577 'Bitcoin Price Regime Shifts: Bayesian MCMC and HMM Analysis'
strategies.concept: Gaussian Mixture Model with Vector Autoregression for market regime detection. Improvement over our HMM: GMM-VAR enables unsupervised, distribution-based regime identification WITHOUT requiring fixed temporal dependencies. This means it can capture abrupt, non-sequential, and overlapping regime shifts that HMMs miss. Particularly relevant for crypto where regimes can shift intra-day (e.g., sudden regulatory news). Use 5 features: returns, volatility, volume, funding rate, correlation with SPX. Output: probability of being in each regime (bull/bear/chop/crisis) at each timestep.
strategies.data_requirements: Same data as our HMM regime module (returns, volatility, volume — already have all)
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have HMM 3-state regime (hmm_regime.py) and CUSUM regime (cusum_regime). GMM-VAR is a different statistical approach that handles non-sequential regime transitions — HMM assumes sequential state transitions which crypto violates.

strategies.name: Realized Correlation Breakout
strategies.reference: RIT Thesis (2025) 'Crypto Social Sentiment NLP On-Chain Correlation Trading Alpha'; Multiple quant research sources on cross-asset correlation regime changes
strategies.concept: Track rolling 30-day correlation between BTC and major risk assets (SPX, NASDAQ, Gold, DXY). When correlation breaks its 90-day regime (e.g., BTC-SPX correlation drops from 0.7 to 0.2 within 2 weeks), it signals a regime change. Historically, BTC decorrelation from equities precedes either: (1) a major BTC-specific rally (idiosyncratic alpha), or (2) a BTC-specific crash. The DIRECTION of the decorrelation move matters: if BTC decorrelates UPWARD (BTC rising while SPX flat), it's strongly bullish. If BTC decorrelates DOWNWARD, it's a warning. This is a proven tradfi quant signal adapted for crypto.
strategies.data_requirements: BTC price (have), SPX/NASDAQ/Gold/DXY data (can get from Yahoo Finance — already have equity_strategies.py infrastructure)
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have cross-sectional momentum (comparing crypto assets) but NOT cross-asset correlation regime detection. This measures BTC's relationship with traditional markets as a signal source.

strategies.name: Attention-Weighted Multi-Source Confluence
strategies.reference: Nature Scientific Reports (2025) 'Attention-augmented hybrid CNN-LSTM for social media sentiment'; MDPI (2025) 'Transformer+GRU Hybrid'; Multiple 2025 ML papers
strategies.concept: Instead of our current equal-weight or manually-tuned confluence scoring, use an attention mechanism to LEARN which signal sources matter most at each point in time. Feed all existing signals (technical, on-chain, sentiment, options, copy-trader) into a lightweight attention layer that outputs dynamic weights. During high-volatility periods, the model might weight on-chain signals higher; during range-bound markets, it might weight technical signals. This replaces static confluence weights with learned, adaptive weights. The attention weights themselves become interpretable — showing which strategy families are most predictive in current conditions.
strategies.expected_wr: N/A (meta-ensemble, expected to boost portfolio Sharpe by 0.3-0.5)
strategies.data_requirements: All existing signal outputs (already have). Needs PyTorch for attention layer training.
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have confluence_pipeline.py with static/manual weights and fwls_stacker.py. This replaces static weights with LEARNED ATTENTION WEIGHTS that adapt to market conditions — a fundamentally different approach to signal combination.

strategies.name: Hash Rate Difficulty Ribbon + Production Cost Floor
strategies.reference: CoinDesk 'Hash Ribbon Flashes Signal That Often Marks Cyclical Bottoms' (Nov 2025); CoinDesk 'Longest Mining Capitulation Nears End' (Feb 2026); Bitcoin Magazine Pro 'Hash Ribbons'
strategies.concept: Enhanced hash ribbon: combine the standard 30d/60d hashrate MA crossover with BTC PRODUCTION COST as a price floor signal. In Feb 2026, BTC traded below average production cost for the first time since Nov 2022 — a historically reliable deep-value buy signal. The current (March 2026) mining capitulation has lasted 3+ months, one of the longest ever. When hash ribbon recovery signal fires AND price is below production cost, the combined signal has near-100% historical accuracy for marking major bottoms. Add: miner hashprice (revenue per TH/s) as a leading indicator — when hashprice hits 5-year lows, miners sell reserves, creating final capitulation flush.
strategies.data_requirements: Hashrate data (CryptoQuant or blockchain.info — already have hash_ribbon_buy), mining difficulty, electricity cost estimates, miner revenue per TH/s (hashprice from Luxor)
strategies.novel_vs_existing: We have miner_capitulation_recovery and hash_ribbon_buy. This COMBINES them with production cost floor and hashprice — adding the economic viability dimension that makes the signal much more reliable. Also adds the 'duration of capitulation' factor (current one is 3+ months, historically rare).
